title: Ordinary quotient and balancing chain maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its coefficient rings $A_n$ and completed ring sheaf on a scheme $W$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $n\leq m$ and ANY unbounded complex $P$ of completed coefficient modules, let $P_j$ be its termwise ordinary scalar extension to $A_j$ [lem-coef-compact-support-quotient-coordinates]. There are chain maps $a:P_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}P_n$ and $b:P_m\otimes_{B_m}B_n\to P_n$, with $b$ invertible. On each term, $a(s\otimes x)=q(s)\otimes x$ and $b(t\otimes(s\otimes x))=(tq(s))\otimes x$. More precisely, there are component objects $M_m,M_n$ and isomorphisms from the actual scalar-extension objects whose homomorphisms are heterogeneously equal to the identity, with component maps heterogeneously equal to the maps satisfying CompactSupportQuotientModuleSpec. There is no derived comparison square and no K-flatness hypothesis in this statement.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportQuotient_chain_maps (W : Scheme.{u})
    (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W) ℤ) :
    ∃ (a : (compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W m).obj P ⟶
        ((proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars W
          (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W n).obj P))
      (b : ((pbcExtend.{u} (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj ((compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W m).obj P) ⟶
        (compactSupportQuotientComplex l E W n).obj P),
      (∀ i : ℤ, ∃
        (Mm : scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E W m)
        (Mn : scalarReductionTarget.{u, u} l E W n)
        (em : (scalarReductionExtension.{u, u} l E W m).obj (P.X i) ≅ Mm)
        (en : (scalarReductionExtension.{u, u} l E W n).obj (P.X i) ≅ Mn)
        (a₀ : Mm ⟶ (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars W
          (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).obj Mn)
        (b₀ : (pbcExtend (compactSupportLevelSheafQuotient l E W m n h)).obj Mm ⟶ Mn),
        HEq em.hom (𝟙 ((scalarReductionExtension.{u, u} l E W m).obj (P.X i))) ∧
        HEq en.hom (𝟙 ((scalarReductionExtension.{u, u} l E W n).obj (P.X i))) ∧
        HEq (a.f i) a₀ ∧ HEq (b.f i) b₀ ∧
          CompactSupportQuotientModuleSpec l E W m n h (P.X i) Mm Mn em en a₀ b₀) ∧
      IsIso b
